name: Matplotlib
description: Comprehensive library for creating static, animated and interactive visualizations in Python.
summary: Matplotlib permits generative AI as an assistive tool for contributions when a human contributor takes responsibility, understands and verifies the output, and discloses AI use; autonomous AI agents may not create issues, pull requests or comments. AI-generated prose in pull request descriptions is not accepted, though translating or proof-reading existing text is allowed.
